adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a “sync mode” for token refresh via `refreshOAuthTokens` which is explicitly documented to return “only the access token and expiry date” (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts` comments and the relaxed parsing in `parseRefreshTokenResponse`). Several integrations (Zoom, Office365, Google) were updated to use `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` when validating refreshed tokens under sync mode. However, `packages/app-store/webex/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts` only wraps the refresh HTTP call with `refreshOAuthTokens` and does not switch to `parseRefreshTokenResponse`; it therefore likely continues to validate the response with the existing strict Webex refreshed-token schema (as the finding notes). In sync mode, a minimal `{access_token, expiry...}` payload would fail that strict validation and cause refresh failures. This mismatch is grounded by the presence of sync-mode relaxation utilities in the diff and their absence in the Webex adapter changes.
